description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kadawadduwa, Devinuwara D/S/Division Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820287 (24/0514)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of title determination for specific land parcels (Nos. 1:36, 1:93, and 1:100) with detailed ownership information, property descriptions, and legal encumbrances. The content falls under PART III - LANDS and involves land registration, ownership details, and property rights - all characteristics of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
